relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: Once formed, the NLRP3 inflammasome recruits and activates caspase-1 that cleaves pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 to produce the corresponding mature cytokines, namely IL-1β and IL18

relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Caspase-1 also cleaves the pyroptosis-inducing factor gasdermin D

relationships.subject: Gasdermin D
relationships.evidence_quote: The N-terminal fragment of gasdermin D oligomerizes and forms pores in the host cell membrane, leading to cellular swelling, lysis, and release of cytoplasmic contents in an inflammatory form of cell death, called pyroptosis

relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 inflammasome agonists, such as extracellular ATP, stimulate translocation to the cell surface and activation of purinergic P2X7 receptors

relationships.subject: NRF2
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 activation can also be inhibited by the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) to limit ROS levels

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: chronic oral administration of the NLRP3 inhibitor, MCC950 in a relapsing–remitting EAE mouse model of MS-associated neuropathic pain progressively reversed neuropathic pain behaviour

key_findings: Review: NLRP3 inflammasome (NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1) drives IL-1beta/IL-18 maturation and gasdermin D-mediated pyroptosis, implicated in neuropathic and chronic inflammatory pain.
NLRP3 activation is implicated in MS-associated, post-stroke and chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain models.
